source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Pinnately compound, usually 11–23 leaflets with conspicuously serrate to serrate-crenate margins (genus key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Mature fruit 35 mm diameter or larger; nut with irregular grooves and ridges; edible kernel

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 flora documents juglone and allelopathic potential; source's qualitative ecology is not a planting-management recommendation
Distinctive fruit size and irregular nut sculpture contrasted against J. major and J. microcarpa
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
